changelog: New lead form (#3821): a company name OR a contact name is required (`resolveNewLeadNames()` in `src/lib/newLeadNameRule.ts`, shared by the dialog, `POST /api/sales/leads` and `POST /api/admin/marketing-accounts`; 400 `name_required`); a contact alone names the account, a company alone leaves the contact empty. The name and e-mail/phone rules show inline under their fields instead of in the banner. A nameless phone-only lead is named after its account instead of its `tel.<digits>` key (`leadFallbackName()`), and backfill `0038-lead-phone-names` renames the existing ones. "Complete follow-up" opens the interaction form on the board hand-off's pick (`followUpInteractionType()` in `src/lib/leadHandoffRule.ts`), else a call.

en: New lead: a company name or a contact name is enough — with only a contact, the account gets that name.
New lead: missing details are shown right under the field.
A lead entered with only a phone number no longer shows the number as its name.
Completing a handed-off follow-up preselects the right interaction type (call, e-mail or meeting).
tr: Yeni lead: firma adı ya da muhatap adı yeterli — yalnızca muhatap girilirse hesap onun adıyla açılır.
Yeni lead: eksik bilgiler artık ilgili alanın hemen altında gösteriliyor.
Yalnızca telefon numarasıyla girilen bir lead'in adı artık numara olarak görünmüyor.
Devredilen bir takip tamamlanırken etkileşim türü (arama, e-posta ya da toplantı) önceden seçili geliyor.
de: Neuer Lead: Ein Firmenname oder ein Ansprechpartner reicht — mit nur einem Ansprechpartner bekommt der Account dessen Namen.
Neuer Lead: Fehlende Angaben stehen jetzt direkt unter dem Feld.
Ein Lead, der nur mit einer Telefonnummer angelegt wurde, zeigt die Nummer nicht mehr als Namen.
Beim Abschließen einer übergebenen Wiedervorlage ist die richtige Art der Interaktion (Anruf, E-Mail oder Termin) vorausgewählt.
